title: Country Roads USA Nashville Dinner Theater Show
includes: Plated Dinner / Meal Service (Unless Dinner Option Add-On Purchased) (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
A high-energy live theatrical experience that brings the heart of country music to the stage. From the timeless sounds of Hank Williams and Patsy Cline to the arena anthems of Garth Brooks and Reba McEntire, this show celebrates the voices and songs that shaped a genre.

Blending powerful live performances with striking visuals, Country Roads USA takes you on a journey through the eras of country music—from its humble beginnings to its biggest stages—capturing the stories, sounds, and spirit that define it, and delivering an unforgettable night of entertainment.

This show is family friendly, and kids show tickets are free. The venue also has free parking.

Come enjoy your evening with us!
